title: Pregnenolone Carbamate Derivatives as Selective Cholinesterase Inhibitors: Multimodal Evaluation Including DNA and HSA Interactions.
authors: Akca, Sura; Ilkar Erdagi, Sevinc; Ozbagci, Duygu Inci
one_liner_zh: 该文研究孕烯醇酮氨基甲酸酯衍生物作为胆碱酯酶抑制剂，虽涉及DNA小沟结合和HSA互作的对接与光谱分析，但核心是药物小分子-生物大分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA转录因子结合体系，且方法以常规对接和实验为主，与课题TF-DNA互作建模关联较弱。
abstract: Pregnenolone-carbamate derivatives were synthesized and evaluated as potential multifunctional agents with cholinesterase inhibitory and neuroprotective properties. Among them, P3, P5, and P9 exhibited the most promising profiles and were subjected to integrated spectroscopic, biochemical, and computational analyses. Inhibition assays revealed selective acetylcholinesterase (AChE) inhibition by P3 (IC(50) = 0.11 muM), butyrylcholinesterase inhibition (BuChE) selectivity for P5 (IC(50) = 0.47 muM), and dual inhibition by P9. Fluorescence and UV-vis studies indicated minor groove binding to DNA with log K(app) values around 5.85, while static quenching with human serum albumin (HSA) was observed, with log K(A) values up to 2.25. Docking studies supported these findings, showing favorable binding energies for DNA (-8.6 kcal/mol) and HSA (-9.7 kcal/mol), and predicted localization within the DNA minor groove and Sudlow sites on HSA. Cytotoxicity assays on HT22 cells indicated high viability (> 75% at 40 microM), suggesting a favorable safety margin. These results offer a molecular-level understanding of the pharmacodynamic and pharmacokinetic properties of these compounds and support their potential for further in vivo evaluation.
abstract_zh: 合成了孕烯醇酮-氨基甲酸酯衍生物，并评估其作为具有胆碱酯酶抑制和神经保护特性的潜在多功能药物。其中，P3、P5和P9表现出最有前景的特征，并进行了综合的光谱、生化和计算分析。抑制实验显示，P3对乙酰胆碱酯酶（AChE）具有选择性抑制（IC(50) = 0.11 muM），P5对丁酰胆碱酯酶（BuChE）具有选择性抑制（IC(50) = 0.47 muM），而P9则表现出双重抑制。荧光和紫外-可见光谱研究表明，这些化合物与DNA发生小沟结合，log K(app)值约为5.85，同时观察到与人血清白蛋白（HSA）的静态猝灭，log K(A)值最高达2.25。对接研究支持了这些发现，显示与DNA（-8.6 kcal/mol）和HSA（-9.7 kcal/mol）的结合能有利，并预测其定位于DNA小沟和HSA上的Sudlow位点。对HT22细胞的细胞毒性实验表明，细胞存活率较高（在40 microM时> 75%），提示具有良好的安全范围。这些结果在分子水平上提供了对这些化合物的药效学和药代动力学特性的理解，并支持其进一步进行体内评估的潜力。
